title: Milo Ventimiglia says family is settled in new home after losing two houses in LA fires
summary_full: Milo Ventimiglia and wife Jarah Mariano lost their home and another house under construction in the January 2025 Los Angeles fires, when she was 38 weeks pregnant. Nearly two years later, the actor says the family has settled into a new home with their two children, while reflecting on the loss, memories and rebuilding their lives.
